title: Your first invoice
description: Send your first invoice in a minute. By the end, your client receives a numbered invoice by email, and you can follow its payment from this list.

steps.title: Start a new invoice
steps.text: Start a new invoice. It begins as a draft, so nothing leaves until you decide.

steps.title: Pick your client
steps.text: Pick your client. Their address and tax ID fill in by themselves.

steps.title: Add what you sold
steps.text: Add what you sold. Type a description and a price; the VAT is computed for you.
Why drafts have no number. Invoice numbers must follow each other with no gap, so a number is only given when the invoice is sent.

steps.title: Check the total
steps.text: Check the total. VAT included, it is exactly what your client will pay.
Sending is final. Once sent, an invoice can no longer be edited, only cancelled with a credit note.

steps.title: Send it
steps.text: Send it. It gets its number now, and your client receives it by email.
